description: Registry of the ENGINE's step namespaces (README 3.3.5, ADR-007 D23). A uses name's namespace is its first two dot-separated segments, and a uses name has at least three segments. Every namespace whose first segment is 'tributary' is reserved: it resolves only through this file, and a channel spec cannot declare one. Any other namespace is bound per channel by spec.pipeline.stepNamespaces, so a third-party or customer step package never needs a change here. A uses name resolves only if exactly one installed tributary.steps entry point carries it and that entry point's distribution, PEP 503 normalised, equals the namespace's; otherwise the spec is refused and nothing is imported. contracts/validate.py checks that every namespace here is reserved, that every channel-spec example's uses names a registered or spec-declared namespace, and that the tributary.steps entry points declared in packages/*/pyproject.toml match this file both ways. tributary-runtime checks its runtime copy against this file (two-way, like the capability registry). Adding a namespace is additive and needs architect approval plus security-reviewer on the package.
namespace_rule: first two dot-separated segments of the uses name; a uses name with fewer than three segments has no namespace and is refused
distribution_match: PEP 503 normalised name (lowercase; runs of '-', '_', '.' become '-'), compared for equality. An entry point with no distribution metadata never matches

tributary.core.note: Built-in steps (README 3.3.2). Registered by tributary-runtime, not by a tributary-core distribution, which is why the distribution cannot be derived from the prefix
